text:
Type: arched white framed wall mirror
Use: hanging over a sideboard, dresser or console, adding light; hallway, bedroom, living room, bathroom
Style: classic, traditional, farmhouse
Materials: painted wood frame with a molded profile, mirror glass
Colors: white, silver reflection
Shape: tall rectangle with a softly arched top, slim stepped frame, clean and elegant, medium visual weight
Feel: bright, elegant, calm, timeless
Goes with: white or pastel walls, light wood, brass or nickel accents; classic, farmhouse or French country rooms
